data.one_liner: An animated menu using a floating action button with customizable items.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget to display an expandable animated menu triggered by a Floating Action Button. Each menu item (Bubble) supports custom titles, icons, colors, and press actions.
use_when: You want a floating action button that expands into multiple custom menu options.
You need an easy way to animate a circular or bubble menu from a FAB.
avoid_when: You need complex navigation drawers or bottom navigation bars.
You want a built-in state management solution instead of manually handling AnimationControllers.
strengths: Fully customizable bubble and icon appearances.
Supports null safety and animation controllers.
weaknesses: Requires manual setup of an AnimationController and CurvedAnimation.
Limited documentation outside of the basic README example.
data.setup_notes: Just add the dependency to pubspec.yml.
data.minimal_example:
FloatingActionBubble(
  items: <Bubble>[
    Bubble(
      title: "Settings",
      iconColor: Colors.white,
      bubbleColor: Colors.blue,
      icon: Icons.settings,
      titleStyle: TextStyle(fontSize: 16, color: Colors.white),
      onPress: () {
        _animationController.reverse();
      },
    ),
  ],
  animation: _animation,
  onPress: () => _animationController.isCompleted
      ? _animationController.reverse()
      : _animationController.forward(),
  iconColor: Colors.blue,
  iconData: Icons.ac_unit,
  backGroundColor: Colors.white,
)
